description: Pre-registered hypothesis registry for Payout Vault research. All hypotheses registered before any OOS data is examined. Nulls are economically valid (not just statistical zero).
note_on_nulls: Null hypotheses are economically valid: they assert that the strategy does not produce a positive expectancy after realistic transaction costs (MNQ round-trip $5.00 commission + 0.5 tick slippage = $7.50 total). A strategy that wins 26% of the time at 3R exactly breaks even. The null is that win rate <= 26%, not that win rate = 0%.

hypotheses.name: Setup Frequency
hypotheses.description: The full 4-step Payout Vault setup (DOL → MSU → Inducement → Sweep → CSD) occurs at a frequency sufficient for meaningful statistical testing on MNQ 5m data.
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Setup frequency >= 2 setups per trading week on average over the OOS period.
hypotheses.null: H0: Setup frequency < 2 setups per trading week. If true, research is halted — insufficient sample size for any statistical conclusion.
hypotheses.null_rationale: Fewer than 2 setups per week produces fewer than 80 setups in a 40-week OOS period. This is insufficient for reliable win-rate estimation (95% CI width > ±11% at 26% base rate).
hypotheses.measurement: Count of qualifying setups per week in OOS period
hypotheses.gate_condition: If H0 not rejected, halt all further Payout Vault research.

hypotheses.name: Positive Expectancy (Entry Type 1)
hypotheses.description: Entry Type 1 (open of next bar after CSD) produces positive expectancy after transaction costs on MNQ.
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Expectancy > $0 per trade after $7.50 round-trip cost.
hypotheses.null: H0: Expectancy <= $0 per trade after costs. Win rate <= 26% at 3R.
hypotheses.null_rationale: At 3R with $7.50 costs, breakeven win rate is 25%. The null asserts the strategy does not clear this hurdle.
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if lower bound of 95% CI on expectancy > $0.

hypotheses.name: Positive Expectancy (Entry Type 2)
hypotheses.description: Entry Type 2 (FVG midpoint limit) produces positive expectancy after transaction costs on MNQ.
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Expectancy > $0 per trade after costs.
hypotheses.null: H0: Expectancy <= $0 per trade after costs.
hypotheses.null_rationale: Same breakeven logic as H-02. Entry Type 2 has lower fill rate, so sample size may be smaller.
hypotheses.measurement: Expectancy per trade for Entry Type 2 only
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if lower bound of 95% CI on expectancy > $0.

hypotheses.name: SMT Filter Improves Win Rate
hypotheses.description: Setups with SMT divergence present at the inducement sweep have a higher win rate than setups without SMT.
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Win rate (SMT present) > Win rate (SMT absent) by at least 5 percentage points.
hypotheses.null: H0: Win rate (SMT present) <= Win rate (SMT absent) + 5pp. SMT does not meaningfully improve win rate.
hypotheses.null_rationale: A 5pp improvement is the minimum economically meaningful difference given the 26% breakeven rate. A 1–2pp improvement would not justify the added complexity of requiring MES data.
hypotheses.measurement: Win rate delta: SMT setups vs non-SMT setups
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate delta > 5pp with p < 0.05.

hypotheses.name: CSD Rule 2 Outperforms Rule 1
hypotheses.description: Setups where CSD is confirmed by Rule 2 (full body engulf) have higher win rate than setups confirmed only by Rule 1 (50% close).
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Win rate (Rule 2) > Win rate (Rule 1 only) by at least 5pp.
hypotheses.null: H0: Win rate (Rule 2) <= Win rate (Rule 1 only) + 5pp.
hypotheses.null_rationale: The source describes Rule 2 as 'stronger'. If it does not produce a measurable win rate improvement, the distinction has no practical value.
hypotheses.measurement: Win rate by CSD rule type
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate delta > 5pp with p < 0.10.

hypotheses.name: Session Regime Dependence
hypotheses.description: Setup win rate differs significantly across trading sessions (London, New York, Asia).
hypotheses.alternative: H1: At least one session has win rate > 31% (5pp above breakeven).
hypotheses.null: H0: No session has win rate > 31%. Win rate is session-independent.
hypotheses.null_rationale: If no session clears 31%, session-based filtering adds no value. The 5pp buffer accounts for estimation error.
hypotheses.measurement: Win rate by session (London: 03:00–08:00 ET, NY: 09:30–16:00 ET, Asia: 20:00–02:00 ET)
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if any session win rate > 31% with p < 0.10.

hypotheses.name: HTF Trend Alignment Improves Win Rate
hypotheses.description: Setups where the LTF MSU direction aligns with the 1h trend (EMA-20 slope) have higher win rate than counter-trend setups.
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Win rate (aligned) > Win rate (counter-trend) by at least 5pp.
hypotheses.null_rationale: Trend alignment is a common filter in systematic strategies. If it does not improve win rate by 5pp, it adds no value.
hypotheses.measurement: Win rate: aligned vs counter-trend setups
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate delta > 5pp with p < 0.10.

hypotheses.name: ATR Regime Dependence
hypotheses.description: Setup win rate is higher in high-ATR (volatile) regimes than in low-ATR regimes.
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Win rate (high ATR quartile) > Win rate (low ATR quartile) by at least 5pp.
hypotheses.null: H0: Win rate does not differ by more than 5pp across ATR quartiles.
hypotheses.null_rationale: ATR regime is a standard market condition filter. If win rate is ATR-independent, no ATR filter is warranted.
hypotheses.measurement: Win rate by ATR(14) quartile at setup time
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate delta > 5pp with p < 0.10.

hypotheses.name: Setup Stability Across Sub-Periods
hypotheses.description: Setup win rate is stable across three equal sub-periods of the OOS window (does not degrade over time).
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Win rate in the final sub-period is within 10pp of the first sub-period.
hypotheses.null: H0: Win rate in the final sub-period is more than 10pp below the first sub-period. The edge is decaying.
hypotheses.null_rationale: A 10pp decay over 9 months would indicate the edge is not stable enough for live deployment.
hypotheses.measurement: Win rate in three equal OOS sub-periods
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate decay < 10pp across sub-periods.

hypotheses.name: Double MSU Trap Frequency
hypotheses.description: Double MSU (fMSS as inducement for real MSS) occurs frequently enough to be a meaningful pitfall filter.
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Double MSU occurs in >= 15% of all setups.
hypotheses.null: H0: Double MSU occurs in < 15% of setups. It is rare and not a meaningful filter.
hypotheses.null_rationale: If double MSU occurs in fewer than 15% of setups, implementing a filter for it adds complexity without meaningful benefit.
hypotheses.measurement: Proportion of setups where a prior fMSS is present
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if double MSU rate >= 15%.

hypotheses.name: CSD Window Length Sensitivity
hypotheses.description: Win rate is not sensitive to the CSD confirmation window (1, 3, or 5 bars).
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Win rate differs by more than 5pp across CSD window variants.
hypotheses.null: H0: Win rate differs by less than 5pp across CSD window variants. The primary choice (3 bars) is robust.
hypotheses.null_rationale: If win rate is insensitive to the CSD window, the primary choice is robust and the ambiguity is not economically meaningful.
hypotheses.measurement: Win rate by CSD window variant
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate range across variants > 5pp.

hypotheses.name: Stop Buffer Sensitivity
hypotheses.description: Expectancy is not sensitive to the stop buffer choice (1 tick, 4 ticks, ATR-based).
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Expectancy differs by more than $10/trade across stop buffer variants.
hypotheses.null: H0: Expectancy differs by less than $10/trade across stop buffer variants. The primary choice (4 ticks) is robust.
hypotheses.null_rationale: A $10/trade difference in expectancy is economically meaningful for a $450 max-risk account.
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if expectancy range across variants > $10/trade.

hypotheses.name: Portfolio Uniqueness vs Existing Models
hypotheses.description: The Payout Vault setup produces trades that are not correlated with existing Atlas Nexus models (A1, B1, SB1, ORB-1).
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Trade overlap (same day, same direction) with any existing model < 30%.
hypotheses.null: H0: Trade overlap >= 30% with at least one existing model. The strategy duplicates existing portfolio coverage.
hypotheses.null_rationale: Per DARWIN doctrine, a new strategy must add unique portfolio value. 30% overlap is the maximum tolerable duplication.
hypotheses.measurement: Trade overlap rate with each existing model
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if overlap < 30% with all existing models.

hypotheses.name: Sweep-Type Sensitivity (Wick vs Close)
hypotheses.description: Win rate is not sensitive to the sweep definition (wick penetration vs close-through).
hypotheses.alternative: H1: Win rate differs by more than 5pp between wick and close-through sweep definitions.
hypotheses.null: H0: Win rate differs by less than 5pp. The primary choice (wick) is robust.
hypotheses.null_rationale: If win rate is insensitive to sweep definition, the primary choice is robust. If sensitive, the choice materially affects results and must be justified.
hypotheses.measurement: Win rate by sweep definition variant
hypotheses.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate delta > 5pp between variants.

experiment_plan.name: Baseline Frequency Scan
experiment_plan.description: Run the full 4-step setup detector on the OOS dataset. Count qualifying setups per week. Report by direction (bullish/bearish) and session.
experiment_plan.data: OOS period: 2025-10-01 to 2026-07-20. MNQ 5m canonical dataset.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: If setup frequency < 2/week, halt all further research.
experiment_plan.output: Setup count, weekly frequency, direction split, session split

experiment_plan.name: Entry Type 1 Expectancy
experiment_plan.description: For all qualifying setups, record Entry Type 1 outcome (win/loss/open). Compute expectancy after $7.50 round-trip cost.
experiment_plan.data: OOS period. MNQ 5m. Entry = open of bar after CSD. Stop = 4 ticks beyond swept inducement. Target = 3R.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if lower 95% CI bound on expectancy > $0.
experiment_plan.output: Win rate, expectancy, profit factor, max drawdown, 95% CI

experiment_plan.name: Entry Type 2 Expectancy
experiment_plan.description: For all qualifying setups where a FVG is present, record Entry Type 2 outcome. Compute expectancy after costs.
experiment_plan.data: OOS period. MNQ 5m. Entry = FVG midpoint limit. Stop = 4 ticks beyond swept inducement. Target = 3R.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if lower 95% CI bound on expectancy > $0.
experiment_plan.output: FVG fill rate, win rate, expectancy, profit factor, 95% CI

experiment_plan.name: SMT Filter Conditional Win Rate
experiment_plan.description: Split setups into SMT-present and SMT-absent groups. Compare win rates. Report separately.
experiment_plan.data: OOS period. MNQ 5m + MES 5m for SMT. SMT window = ±3 bars.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate delta > 5pp with p < 0.05.
experiment_plan.output: Win rate by SMT presence, p-value, effect size

experiment_plan.name: CSD Rule Comparison
experiment_plan.description: Classify each CSD confirmation as Rule 1 only, Rule 2 only, or both. Compare win rates across groups.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate delta > 5pp with p < 0.10.
experiment_plan.output: Win rate by CSD rule type, count per group

experiment_plan.name: Session Win Rate Analysis
experiment_plan.description: Assign each setup to a trading session (London, New York, Asia, Overnight). Compare win rates.
experiment_plan.data: OOS period. MNQ 5m. Session times in ET.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if any session win rate > 31% with p < 0.10.
experiment_plan.output: Win rate by session, setup count per session

experiment_plan.name: Trend Alignment Filter
experiment_plan.description: At setup time, compute 1h EMA-20 slope. Classify setup as aligned or counter-trend. Compare win rates.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate delta > 5pp with p < 0.10.
experiment_plan.output: Win rate by trend alignment, setup count

experiment_plan.name: ATR Regime Conditional Win Rate
experiment_plan.description: At setup time, compute ATR(14) on 5m bars. Assign to quartile. Compare win rates across quartiles.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate delta > 5pp across ATR quartiles with p < 0.10.
experiment_plan.output: Win rate by ATR quartile, setup count per quartile

experiment_plan.name: Sub-Period Stability Test
experiment_plan.description: Divide OOS into three equal sub-periods. Compute win rate in each. Test for decay.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate decay < 10pp across sub-periods.
experiment_plan.output: Win rate per sub-period, trend test

experiment_plan.name: Double MSU Trap Frequency
experiment_plan.description: For each setup, check whether a prior fMSS is present in the same MSU sequence. Count double MSU occurrences.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if double MSU rate >= 15%.
experiment_plan.output: Double MSU rate, win rate for double MSU vs single MSU setups

experiment_plan.name: CSD Window Sensitivity Analysis
experiment_plan.description: Run the full setup detector with CSD windows of 1, 3, and 5 bars. Compare win rates and setup counts.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate range across variants > 5pp.
experiment_plan.output: Win rate and setup count by CSD window variant

experiment_plan.name: Stop Buffer Sensitivity Analysis
experiment_plan.description: Run the full setup detector with stop buffers of 1 tick, 4 ticks, and ATR(14)×0.25. Compare expectancy.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if expectancy range across variants > $10/trade.

experiment_plan.name: Portfolio Overlap Analysis
experiment_plan.description: Compare Payout Vault setup dates and directions with existing Atlas Nexus model trades (A1, B1, SB1, ORB-1). Compute overlap rate.
experiment_plan.data: OOS period. Payout Vault setups vs existing model trade ledger from Sprint 123A.8.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if overlap < 30% with all existing models.
experiment_plan.output: Overlap rate per existing model, correlation matrix

experiment_plan.name: Sweep Definition Sensitivity
experiment_plan.description: Run the full setup detector with wick-penetration and close-through sweep definitions. Compare win rates and setup counts.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Reject H0 if win rate delta > 5pp between variants.
experiment_plan.output: Win rate and setup count by sweep definition

experiment_plan.name: Timeframe Pair Sensitivity
experiment_plan.description: Run the full setup detector with three HTF/LTF pairs (15m/5m, 30m/5m, 1h/15m). Compare setup counts and win rates. This experiment is exploratory — no hypothesis is pre-registered for it.
experiment_plan.data: OOS period. MNQ canonical dataset at 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h.
experiment_plan.gate_condition: Exploratory only. Results inform future hypothesis registration.
experiment_plan.output: Setup count and win rate by timeframe pair
